def _t():
    inner = frozenset([1])
    outer = set([inner])
    element = outer.pop()
    assert type(element) == frozenset, ('assertEqual', type(element), frozenset)
    outer.add(inner)
    outer.remove(inner)
    assert outer == set(), ('assertEqual', outer, set())
    outer.discard(inner)
